description: Whose `process.env` a test file writes. One worker runs both files (`maxWorkers: 1`; a `workerIdleMemoryLimit` makes Jest use a worker process even so). The first file (the larger, so it runs first) sets a variable, checks what an assigned number reads back as, and starts a `node` child that prints the variable; the second reads the variable. Each test's title holds what it saw.
